messages:
ara: Quick idea: implement 'late-bind' tenant reserves in the continuous batcher

ben: Can you summarise the safety model? Late-bind seems good for packing but worried about races and leaked headroom.

ara: Flow: admission returns optimistic credit but doesn't allocate ledger entry. On enqueue if batch > spill_threshold we CAS-create a soft reservation in global ledger (idempotent). Soft TTL short (30-60ms). On runtime commit we promote to hard.

isha: Two concerns: 1) cold-kv/kernel warmup adds tail latency on first token. 2) if CAS fails we must surface clear errors so caller can retry/fallback.

ara: Agreed. Metrics: reserve_create_rate, promotion_latency, promotion_fail_rate, headroom_utilization. Backstops: per-tenant create rate limit, promotion_fail circuit that pins tenant to eager reserves.

ben: Also add ledger reconciler to clean leaked protections after host crash. Ensure createIfAbsent returns stable id or failure so no double-counting.

ops-bot: scheduled-test: pool=latebind-canary start=1768801100 dur=30m

ara: I'll draft a short RFC with invariants, API changes (optimistic admit + ErrReserveFailed), and the experimental config. Thanks for feedback.
